run.question:
Alertmanager alert PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus since 2026-11-17T21:25:20Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alert is a true statement about this cluster: Prometheus prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus discovers zero Alertmanagers because no Alertmanager is deployed at all. The firing rule is loaded in that Prometheus's rule files (expr max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1, for: 10m), and the cluster contains no Alertmanager StatefulSet (cluster-wide StatefulSets: 6, none an Alertmanager), no Alertmanager Deployment (36 cluster-wide Deployments, none), and no Alertmanager Service or Endpoints in namespace prometheus (5 Services and 5 Endpoints, all prometheus/operator/kube-state-metrics/node-exporter). The Pod IP in the Endpoints for service prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus is 100.96.5.74, matching the alert's instance 100.96.5.74:9090, so the alerting instance is this Prometheus. Alert delivery here does not go through an Alertmanager: the prometheus-alert-recorder StatefulSet in data-recorders polls http://prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus.prometheus.svc.cluster.local:9090, so a rule that is permanently true still produces an alert record. The Prometheus pod itself is Running with both containers ready, restartCount 0; it was (re)created at 2026-11-17T21:24:48Z within a broad wave of pod (re)creation across the cluster. The exact trigger (an Alertmanager never deployed versus one removed, or an emptied spec.alerting section in the Prometheus object) is not determinable from the available evidence: prometheus_* self-metrics are absent from the queried store, the Prometheus object and its generated config Secret could not be read, container logs returned no lines, no events exist for namespace prometheus, and change history is not integrated. Hence the conclusion is partial, with the missing Alertmanager as the leading hypothesis and root_cause null (no existing object can be named by the evidence as the origin).

claims.text: The rule PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers is loaded for this Prometheus with expr max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1 and for: 10m, i.e. it fires when Prometheus has fewer than one discovered Alertmanager target.

The Prometheus instance named in the alert is identified by the Endpoints of Service prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus in namespace prometheus: address 100.96.5.74:9090 backed by Pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0, matching the alert instance 100.96.5.74:9090.

The cluster contains 6 StatefulSets and none is an Alertmanager: chi-clickhouse-main-0-0 (clickhouse), jaeger-traces-recorder and prometheus-alert-recorder (data-recorders), topology-monitor (kube-system), opensearch-cluster-master (opensearch) and prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus (prometheus).
The cluster's 36 Deployments include no Alertmanager workload; in namespace prometheus only prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator and prometheus-kube-state-metrics exist, both with readyReplicas 1.

The 5 Services in namespace prometheus are prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator, prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus, prometheus-kube-state-metrics, prometheus-operated and prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter; there is no alertmanager or alertmanager-operated Service.

The 5 Endpoints objects in namespace prometheus have populated subsets only for the operator, prometheus, kube-state-metrics, prometheus-operated and node-exporter Services; no Alertmanager endpoint exists.

The 8 Pods in namespace prometheus include no Alertmanager pod; prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 is Running with containers prometheus and config-reloader both ready and restartCount 0, containers started at 2026-11-17T21:24:49Z.

The Prometheus pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 has creationTimestamp and status.startTime 2026-11-17T21:24:48Z (a newly created pod, not a container restart: its containers have no previous instance), running Prometheus v3.6.0 with config-reloader v0.85.0 and no Alertmanager-related argument.

The rule-files ConfigMap prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0 in namespace prometheus was created at 2026-11-17T21:18:26Z, i.e. the rendered rule set was (re)written shortly before the Prometheus pod was recreated.

Alert delivery in this environment bypasses an Alertmanager: the prometheus-alert-recorder StatefulSet in data-recorders runs a recorder container with env PROMETHEUS_ENDPOINT=http://prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus.prometheus.svc.cluster.local:9090, pulling alerts from the Prometheus API.

The Alertmanager CRD alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com exists in the cluster (created 2026-11-16T22:11:07Z), so the prometheus-operator does support Alertmanager resources; the absence of an Alertmanager StatefulSet is therefore not due to an unsupported resource type.

Events grouped across all namespaces inside the window (26 groups from 92 events, earliest returned event 2026-11-17T21:32:40Z) contain no group whose involvedObject.namespace is prometheus and none whose involved object is an Alertmanager.

Pod creation timestamps show a broad wave of (re)creation in the same window: 19 otel-demo pods at 2026-11-17T21:16:44-21:16:47Z, flagd 21:18:23Z, prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 21:24:48Z, three opentelemetry-collector pods 21:25:20Z, topology-monitor pods 21:28:14Z, metrics-server 21:29:17Z and the prometheus-alert-recorder pod 21:32:40Z.

The rule files also define PrometheusErrorSendingAlertsToSomeAlertmanagers and PrometheusErrorSendingAlertsToAnyAlertmanager, which use prometheus_notifications_errors_total / prometheus_notifications_sent_total ratios; those are separate alerts from the discovered-target-count alert that is firing.
Namespace prometheus contains only two ConfigMaps: kube-root-ca.crt and the prometheus-operator-managed rule-files ConfigMap; no Alertmanager configuration ConfigMap exists there.

Leading explanation: the Prometheus object prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus has no Alertmanager target to configure, because no Alertmanager custom resource/workload is deployed in this cluster (no Alertmanager StatefulSet, Deployment, Service or Endpoints anywhere), so prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered stays at 0 and the rule is permanently true.

If the rule's for: 10m is applied to the reported alert start 2026-11-17T21:25:20Z, the underlying expression (max_over_time(...alertmanagers_discovered[5m]) < 1) was already true by about 2026-11-17T21:15:20Z, i.e. before the Prometheus pod was recreated at 21:24:48Z; the zero-Alertmanager condition therefore likely predates that pod recreation. The reported start is untrusted alert payload data and this derivation is not directly verified.

Rejected as the cause: the recreation of Pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 at 2026-11-17T21:24:48Z. The pod is Running with both containers ready and restartCount 0, and the firing expression counts configured/discovered Alertmanager targets, which a process restart does not change; a restart alone cannot make a configured Alertmanager disappear from discovery.

Rejected as the cause of this alert: a network/reachability failure between Prometheus and a running Alertmanager. The firing expression tests prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered (a count of discovered targets), not notification errors; send failures are covered by the separate PrometheusErrorSendingAlertsToSomeAlertmanagers / PrometheusErrorSendingAlertsToAnyAlertmanager rules in the same file.

Prometheus is not down: its pod and both containers are ready with 0 restarts, and the prometheus-operator Deployment (prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator) is available with readyReplicas 1, so the missing Alertmanager cannot be explained by a crashed Prometheus or a stopped operator.

Confirm in the Prometheus object prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus whether spec.alerting.alertmanagers is empty; if alerting is intended, deploy an Alertmanager resource (kube-prometheus-stack alertmanager enabled) so the operator creates its StatefulSet, governing Service and the alerting targets in Prometheus's generated config; if alerting is not intended, disable or remove the PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers rule so the recorder stops reporting this standing condition.

gaps: The value of prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered could not be observed: a metric-name listing for {__name__=~"prometheus_.*"} inside 2026-11-17T20:25:20Z-22:14:58Z returned no names, an instant query for prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered at 2026-11-17T22:14:00Z returned no series, {__name__=~"kube_.*"} returned no names, and get_prometheus_target for job prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus reported 0 active targets and no jobs; these no_data views cannot confirm or refute the gauge value.

The Prometheus custom resource prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus and its generated config Secret could not be read (Secrets are not readable and the prometheuses kind is not queryable), so whether spec.alerting.alertmanagers is empty and whether it was changed during the window is unverified.

Whether an Alertmanager object or StatefulSet existed earlier and was removed could not be established: the Alertmanager kind is not queryable, no Alertmanager resource remains, and the change_history integration is not available.

Container logs were unavailable for every pod tried (prometheus and config-reloader in prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0, kube-prometheus-stack in prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator-57d68989cc-hkbnh, recorder in prometheus-alert-recorder-0): each stream returned 0 lines, so no application-level evidence of config reload or alerting errors exists.

No events were returned for namespace prometheus, and the earliest event inside the window is 2026-11-17T21:32:40Z (after the alert started), so the trigger of the 2026-11-17T21:24:48Z Prometheus pod recreation and of the 2026-11-17T21:18:26Z rule-files rewrite remains unknown.
A cluster-wide NetworkPolicy listing and a namespace-prometheus PersistentVolumeClaim listing each returned zero objects with no_data status and therefore could not be used as evidence of absence.

Whether the Prometheus had Alertmanagers configured before the alert started is unknown, so it cannot be determined whether this is a new fault (Alertmanager removed) or a pre-existing deployment gap.
next_steps: Read the Prometheus CR prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus (spec.alerting.alertmanagers) and the generated config Secret prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus to confirm the alerting section is empty and when it changed.

Check whether an Alertmanager resource ever existed in this environment (for example via cluster audit/change history) and whether kube-prometheus-stack was installed or upgraded with Alertmanager disabled around 2026-11-17T21:16-21:25Z.

If alerting is required, deploy/enable Alertmanager in namespace prometheus and verify that prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered becomes 1 and the alert clears; if not, exclude the kube-prometheus-stack Prometheus alerting rules from this environment.

content:
groups:
- name: prometheus
  rules:
  - alert: PrometheusBadConfig
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has failed to
        reload its configuration.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusbadconfig
      summary: Failed Prometheus configuration reload.
    expr: |-
      # Without max_over_time, failed scrapes could create false negatives, see
      # https://www.robustperception.io/alerting-on-gauges-in-prometheus-2-0 for details.
      max_over_time(prometheus_config_last_reload_successful{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) == 0
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: PrometheusSDRefreshFailure
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has failed to
        refresh SD with mechanism {{$labels.mechanism}}.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheussdrefreshfailure
      summary: Failed Prometheus SD refresh.
    expr: increase(prometheus_sd_refresh_failures_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[10m])
      > 0
    for: 20m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusKubernetesListWatchFailures
    annotations:
      description: Kubernetes service discovery of Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}}
        is experiencing {{ printf "%.0f" $value }} failures with LIST/WATCH requests
        to the Kubernetes API in the last 5 minutes.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheuskuberneteslistwatchfailures
      summary: Requests in Kubernetes SD are failing.
    expr: increase(prometheus_sd_kubernetes_failures_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusNotificationQueueRunningFull
    annotations:
      description: Alert notification queue of Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}}
        is running full.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusnotificationqueuerunningfull
      summary: Prometheus alert notification queue predicted to run full in less than
        30m.
    expr: |-
      # Without min_over_time, failed scrapes could create false negatives, see
      # https://www.robustperception.io/alerting-on-gauges-in-prometheus-2-0 for details.
      (
        predict_linear(prometheus_notifications_queue_length{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m], 60 * 30)
      >
        min_over_time(prometheus_notifications_queue_capacity{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      )
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusErrorSendingAlertsToSomeAlertmanagers
    annotations:
      description: '{{ printf "%.1f" $value }}% of alerts sent by Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}}
        to Alertmanager {{$labels.alertmanager}} were affected by errors.'
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheuserrorsendingalertstosomealertmanagers
      summary: More than 1% of alerts sent by Prometheus to a specific Alertmanager
        were affected by errors.
    expr: |-
      (
        rate(prometheus_notifications_errors_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      /
        rate(prometheus_notifications_sent_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      )
      * 100
      > 1
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} is not connected
        to any Alertmanagers.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusnotconnectedtoalertmanagers
      summary: Prometheus is not connected to any Alertmanagers.
    expr: |-
      # Without max_over_time, failed scrapes could create false negatives, see
      # https://www.robustperception.io/alerting-on-gauges-in-prometheus-2-0 for details.
      max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusTSDBReloadsFailing
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has detected {{$value
        | humanize}} reload failures over the last 3h.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheustsdbreloadsfailing
      summary: Prometheus has issues reloading blocks from disk.
    expr: increase(prometheus_tsdb_reloads_failures_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[3h])
      > 0
    for: 4h
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusTSDBCompactionsFailing
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has detected {{$value
        | humanize}} compaction failures over the last 3h.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheustsdbcompactionsfailing
      summary: Prometheus has issues compacting blocks.
    expr: increase(prometheus_tsdb_compactions_failed_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[3h])
      > 0
    for: 4h
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusNotIngestingSamples
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} is not ingesting
        samples.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusnotingestingsamples
      summary: Prometheus is not ingesting samples.
    expr: |-
      (
        sum without(type) (rate(prometheus_tsdb_head_samples_appended_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])) <= 0
      and
        (
          sum without(scrape_job) (prometheus_target_metadata_cache_entries{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}) > 0
        or
          sum without(rule_group) (prometheus_rule_group_rules{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}) > 0
        )
      )
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusDuplicateTimestamps
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} is dropping {{
        printf "%.4g" $value  }} samples/s with different values but duplicated timestamp.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusduplicatetimestamps
      summary: Prometheus is dropping samples with duplicate timestamps.
    expr: rate(prometheus_target_scrapes_sample_duplicate_timestamp_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusOutOfOrderTimestamps
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} is dropping {{
        printf "%.4g" $value  }} samples/s with timestamps arriving out of order.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusoutofordertimestamps
      summary: Prometheus drops samples with out-of-order timestamps.
    expr: rate(prometheus_target_scrapes_sample_out_of_order_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusRemoteStorageFailures
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} failed to send
        {{ printf "%.1f" $value }}% of the samples to {{ $labels.remote_name}}:{{
        $labels.url }}
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusremotestoragefailures
      summary: Prometheus fails to send samples to remote storage.
    expr: |-
      (
        (rate(prometheus_remote_storage_failed_samples_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) or rate(prometheus_remote_storage_samples_failed_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]))
      /
        (
          (rate(prometheus_remote_storage_failed_samples_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) or rate(prometheus_remote_storage_samples_failed_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]))
        +
          (rate(prometheus_remote_storage_succeeded_samples_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) or rate(prometheus_remote_storage_samples_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]))
        )
      )
      * 100
      > 1
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: PrometheusRemoteWriteBehind
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} remote write is
        {{ printf "%.1f" $value }}s behind for {{ $labels.remote_name}}:{{ $labels.url
        }}.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusremotewritebehind
      summary: Prometheus remote write is behind.
    expr: |-
      # Without max_over_time, failed scrapes could create false negatives, see
      # https://www.robustperception.io/alerting-on-gauges-in-prometheus-2-0 for details.
      (
        max_over_time(prometheus_remote_storage_queue_highest_timestamp_seconds{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      -
        max_over_time(prometheus_remote_storage_queue_highest_sent_timestamp_seconds{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      )
      > 120
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: PrometheusRemoteWriteDesiredShards
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} remote write desired
        shards calculation wants to run {{ $value }} shards for queue {{ $labels.remote_name}}:{{
        $labels.url }}, which is more than the max of {{ printf `prometheus_remote_storage_shards_max{instance="%s",job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}`
        $labels.instance | query | first | value }}.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusremotewritedesiredshards
      summary: Prometheus remote write desired shards calculation wants to run more
        than configured max shards.
    expr: |-
      # Without max_over_time, failed scrapes could create false negatives, see
      # https://www.robustperception.io/alerting-on-gauges-in-prometheus-2-0 for details.
      (
        max_over_time(prometheus_remote_storage_shards_desired{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      >
        max_over_time(prometheus_remote_storage_shards_max{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      )
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusRuleFailures
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has failed to
        evaluate {{ printf "%.0f" $value }} rules in the last 5m.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusrulefailures
      summary: Prometheus is failing rule evaluations.
    expr: increase(prometheus_rule_evaluation_failures_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: PrometheusMissingRuleEvaluations
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has missed {{
        printf "%.0f" $value }} rule group evaluations in the last 5m.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusmissingruleevaluations
      summary: Prometheus is missing rule evaluations due to slow rule group evaluation.
    expr: increase(prometheus_rule_group_iterations_missed_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusTargetLimitHit
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has dropped {{
        printf "%.0f" $value }} targets because the number of targets exceeded the
        configured target_limit.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheustargetlimithit
      summary: Prometheus has dropped targets because some scrape configs have exceeded
        the targets limit.
    expr: increase(prometheus_target_scrape_pool_exceeded_target_limit_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusLabelLimitHit
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has dropped {{
        printf "%.0f" $value }} targets because some samples exceeded the configured
        label_limit, label_name_length_limit or label_value_length_limit.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheuslabellimithit
      summary: Prometheus has dropped targets because some scrape configs have exceeded
        the labels limit.
    expr: increase(prometheus_target_scrape_pool_exceeded_label_limits_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusScrapeBodySizeLimitHit
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has failed {{
        printf "%.0f" $value }} scrapes in the last 5m because some targets exceeded
        the configured body_size_limit.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusscrapebodysizelimithit
      summary: Prometheus has dropped some targets that exceeded body size limit.
    expr: increase(prometheus_target_scrapes_exceeded_body_size_limit_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusScrapeSampleLimitHit
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has failed {{
        printf "%.0f" $value }} scrapes in the last 5m because some targets exceeded
        the configured sample_limit.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusscrapesamplelimithit
      summary: Prometheus has failed scrapes that have exceeded the configured sample
        limit.
    expr: increase(prometheus_target_scrapes_exceeded_sample_limit_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusTargetSyncFailure
    annotations:
      description: '{{ printf "%.0f" $value }} targets in Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}}
        have failed to sync because invalid configuration was supplied.'
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheustargetsyncfailure
      summary: Prometheus has failed to sync targets.
    expr: increase(prometheus_target_sync_failed_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[30m])
      > 0
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: PrometheusHighQueryLoad
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} query API has
        less than 20% available capacity in its query engine for the last 15 minutes.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheushighqueryload
      summary: Prometheus is reaching its maximum capacity serving concurrent requests.
    expr: avg_over_time(prometheus_engine_queries{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      / max_over_time(prometheus_engine_queries_concurrent_max{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0.8
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusErrorSendingAlertsToAnyAlertmanager
    annotations:
      description: '{{ printf "%.1f" $value }}% minimum errors while sending alerts
        from Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} to any Alertmanager.'
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheuserrorsendingalertstoanyalertmanager
      summary: Prometheus encounters more than 3% errors sending alerts to any Alertmanager.
    expr: |-
      min without (alertmanager) (
        rate(prometheus_notifications_errors_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus",alertmanager!~``}[5m])
      /
        rate(prometheus_notifications_sent_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus",alertmanager!~``}[5m])
      )
      * 100
      > 3
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: critical
